remarks: Welcome home to this large, beautifully maintained one-bedroom condo located on the top floor of an elevator building overlooking the scenic Norwalk Green. With high ceilings and wall-to-wall carpeting, this bright and airy unit offers both comfort and style in a prime location.  The kitchen is fully equipped with a dishwasher, large refrigerator, four-burner stove, and abundant cabinet space - perfect for cooking and entertaining. The bedroom features a custom-designed, floor-to-ceiling armoire complete with lined jewelry drawers, providing elegant and practical storage solutions.
